candidates.text: I WANT TO NOTE THAT THIS YEAR I FILED A BUDGET AMENDMENT TO ALLOCATE $500,000 FOR EQUIPMENT AND RESOURCES FOR THE BOSTON POLICE CRIME LAB.

IT'S THE MOST ADVANCED TESTING FOR SEXUAL ASSAULT KITS DURING THE BUDGET CYCLE IN 20 2024, WE VOTED INTERNALLY ON AN AMENDMENT TO REALLOCATE 1 MILLION WITHIN THE BOSTON POLICE DEPARTMENT TO SUPPORT THE WORK OF THE BOSTON
I NOTED TO THE BOARD OF MY CONCERNS THAT THE POSITION OF THE BOSTON POLICE CRIME LAB DIRECTOR HAS BEEN VACANT FOR OVER TWO YEARS.
IN ADDITION, I SHARED THAT LAST YEAR THE CITY COUNCIL VOTED TO INTERNALLY.
WERE YOU TOLD OR WERE YOU COUNCILOR FLYNN TOLD THAT THERE'S SOME EMERGENCY IN THE CITY THAT NOBODY FROM THE POLICE DEPARTMENT COULD COME TO THIS IMPORTANT COUNCIL HEARING ?
UM, LIKE I SAID AT THE BEGINNING, I'M HAPPY TO WORK WITH YOU AND THE ADMINISTRATION TO TRY TO FIND A DATE THAT WORKS FOR PARTNERS.
UM, I DO WANT TO READ A LITTLE BIT OF THE NOTES I, I WORKED ON AS IT RELATES TO THE RESOLUTION WHY I FILED THAT.

UM THE STAFFING SHORTAGE HAVE IMPACTED THE TIME IN WHICH THE SEXUAL ASSAULT KITS ARE TESTED DURING THE FY 25 BUDGET PROCESS ,THE CITY CODE COUNCIL VOTED TO INTERNALLY REALLOCATE $1 MILLION TO THE BOSTON POLICE DEPARTMENT
AND INDICATED THAT THE FUNDING WAS NOT APPROVED.
